subject: Chemistry
title: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes
summary: Haloalkanes mein C–X bond polar hai (Cδ⁺–Xδ⁻), isliye carbon par nucleophiles attack karte hain. R–X ki reactivity: R–I > R–Br > R–Cl > R–F (kamzor bond, achha leaving group).
Nucleophilic substitution SN2 (ek step, peeche se attack, inversion, 1° halides pasand) ya SN1 (carbocation, racemisation, 3° halides aur polar protic solvents pasand) se hota hai.
Alcoholic KOH ke saath haloalkanes elimination (dehydrohalogenation) karke alkenes banate hain; zyada substituted alkene major hota hai (Saytzeff rule).
Haloarenes nucleophiles ke prati bahut kam reactive hain (resonance se C=X par partial double bond, sp² carbon). Ye ortho/para par electrophilic substitution karte hain.

formulas.name: From alcohols
formulas.formula: ROH + HX (ZnCl₂ for HCl) → RX;  ROH + PCl₅/PCl₃/SOCl₂ → RCl
formulas.note: SOCl₂ sabse achha: by-products SO₂ aur HCl gases hain, pure RCl bachta hai — yaad rakho.

formulas.name: SN2 mechanism
formulas.formula: rate = k[RX][Nu⁻];  one step;  inversion (Walden);  CH₃X > 1° > 2° > 3°
formulas.when: Strong nucleophile aur aprotic solvent ke saath primary halides.
formulas.mistake: Steric hindrance 3° carbon par SN2 rok deta hai — wahan SN2 mat lagao.

formulas.name: Nucleophilicity in a polar protic solvent
formulas.formula: I⁻ > Br⁻ > Cl⁻ > F⁻;   RO⁻ > C₆H₅O⁻;   e.g. towards CH₃Br in methanol: I⁻ > C₂H₅O⁻ > C₆H₅O⁻ > F⁻
formulas.when: Paani/alcohols mein nucleophiles ka order (SN2 rate).
formulas.note: Chhote, hard anions (F⁻) solvent se H-bonding mein kas ke bandhe rehte hain, isliye dheere react karte hain; phenoxide ethoxide se kamzor kyunki charge ring mein delocalise hota hai. Aprotic solvents (DMSO, acetone) mein halide order ulta: F⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻.

formulas.name: SN1 mechanism
formulas.formula: rate = k[RX];  carbocation intermediate;  racemisation;  3° > 2° > 1° > CH₃X
formulas.when: Polar protic solvents mein tertiary/benzylic/allylic halides.

formulas.name: Elimination (dehydrohalogenation)
formulas.formula: R–CH₂–CH₂X + alc. KOH → R–CH=CH₂ + KX + H₂O
formulas.mistake: Aqueous KOH → substitution (alcohol); alcoholic KOH → elimination (alkene) — confuse mat karo.

formulas.name: Saytzeff (Zaitsev) rule
formulas.formula: the more substituted alkene is the major product of elimination

formulas.name: Ambident nucleophiles
formulas.formula: KCN → R–CN (alkyl cyanide);  AgCN → R–NC (isocyanide);  KNO₂ → R–ONO;  AgNO₂ → R–NO₂

formulas.name: Grignard reagent
formulas.formula: R–X + Mg (dry ether) → RMgX;  RMgX + H₂O → R–H
formulas.mistake: Bilkul dry rakhna zaroori — thoda bhi paani (ya –OH, –NH) ise nasht kar deta hai.

formulas.name: Nucleophilic substitution in haloarenes
formulas.formula: needs drastic conditions (Dow's process: 623 K, 300 atm) unless –NO₂ groups are at ortho/para
formulas.mistake: o/p-NO₂ groups ise bahut aasaan banate hain; meta-NO₂ ka kam asar — position check karo.

examples.title: SN1 ya SN2?
examples.problem: OH⁻ ke saath SN2 se kaun tez react karega: CH₃Br ya (CH₃)₃CBr?
examples.solution: CH₃Br — peeche se attack ke liye koi steric hindrance nahi. (CH₃)₃CBr stable 3° carbocation se SN1 karta hai.

examples.title: Stereochemistry
examples.solution: (S)-butan-2-ol: SN2 configuration ulta kar deta hai. SN1 se lagbhag racemic mixture banta.

examples.title: KCN vs AgCN
examples.problem: CH₃CH₂Br KCN ke saath aur AgCN ke saath?
examples.solution: KCN (ionic, C attack karta hai) → CH₃CH₂CN; AgCN (covalent, N attack karta hai) → CH₃CH₂NC.

examples.title: Chlorobenzene unreactive kyun?
examples.problem: Chlorobenzene nucleophilic substitution se kyun bachta hai?
examples.solution: Resonance se C–Cl bond partial double bond jaisa, carbon sp² (electrons kas kar pakadta hai), phenyl cation unstable, aur electron-rich ring nucleophiles ko repel karti hai.

examples.title: Finkelstein
examples.problem: Ethyl chloride ko ethyl iodide mein badlo.
examples.solution: Dry acetone mein NaI ke saath garam karo: C₂H₅Cl + NaI → C₂H₅I + NaCl (NaCl precipitate hokar reaction aage badhata hai).

topics.title: Classification and nomenclature
topics.explain: Mono-, di-, polyhalo compounds; alkyl (1°, 2°, 3°), allylic, benzylic, vinylic aur aryl halides. Vinylic aur aryl halides mein X sp² carbon par hai aur SN reactions mein unreactive hain.

topics.title: Physical properties
topics.explain: Boiling points halogen ke size (RI > RBr > RCl > RF) aur chain length ke saath badhte hain, branching se ghat-te hain. Haloalkanes paani mein bahut kam ghulte hain. p-Dichlorobenzene ka melting point o- aur m-isomers se zyada (symmetrical, achha pack).

topics.title: Factors deciding SN1 vs SN2
topics.explain: Substrate: 1° → SN2, 3° → SN1, 2° → dono. Strong nucleophile aur aprotic solvent SN2; weak nucleophile aur polar protic solvent (paani, alcohols) SN1. Benzylic aur allylic halides SN1 se tez (resonance-stabilised carbocations). Bridgehead halides (1-bromobicyclo[2.2.2]octane, 1-bromonorbornane) SN1 se bahut hi dheere — rigid cage carbocation ko planar nahi hone deta; zyada strained norbornyl sabse slow. Doosri taraf (C₆H₅)₃C⁺ bahut stable (teen rings charge baantte hain), isliye trityl halides sabse tez.

topics.title: Optical activity basics
topics.explain: Chiral molecule (chaar alag groups wala carbon) apni mirror image par superimpose nahi hota aur plane-polarised light ghumaata hai. Enantiomers barabar par ulti direction mein ghumaate hain; 50:50 mixture (racemic) optically inactive.

topics.title: Electrophilic substitution in haloarenes
topics.explain: Halogen deactivating par o/p-directing: chlorobenzene halogenation, nitration, sulphonation aur Friedel–Crafts mein o- aur p-products deta hai (p major).

topics.title: Polyhalogen compounds and environment
topics.explain: CH₂Cl₂ (solvent), CHCl₃ (chloroform, pehle anaesthetic; dark bottles mein rakhte hain kyunki light mein zehreela phosgene banta hai), CHI₃ (iodoform, antiseptic), CCl₄ (solvent, ozone layer ko nuksaan), freon (CFCs, refrigerants, ozone depletion) aur DDT (insecticide, food chains mein tikta hai).

ratta: SN2: 1°, inversion, one step;  SN1: 3°, racemisation, carbocation.
Aq. KOH → alcohol;  alc. KOH → alkene (Saytzeff).
KCN → RCN;  AgCN → RNC;  KNO₂ → RONO;  AgNO₂ → RNO₂.
Protic solvent: I⁻ > C₂H₅O⁻ > C₆H₅O⁻ > F⁻ (F⁻ sabse zyada solvated).
SN1: Ph₃C–X sabse tez;  bridgehead halides bahut slow (planar carbocation nahi).
